# OpenSMM Protocol

> Open, provider-neutral protocol for ordering and executing social media
> growth services by AI agents. MCP is one transport; REST /v0 is the
> canonical HTTP binding. Gateways route and measure — with direct settlement
> (x402, USDC on Base) money flows agent → provider and never transits the
> gateway.

## Key facts for agents

- Install: `npx -y @opensmm/mcp-server` (npm, stdio, Node.js >= 22.18, no API
  key needed). MCP Registry entry: io.github.opensmm-protocol/mcp-server,
  search https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=opensmm.
  No public remote endpoint yet: run the package locally.
- Protocol version: 0.1.0, URL prefix /v0.
- One rule: the same operation via REST and MCP yields the same domain
  objects. Same clientReference → same orderId on any transport.
- Money is decimal strings on integer micro-units. Never floats.
- Idempotency is protocol-level: Idempotency-Key header (REST) /
  clientReference (MCP). Replay returns the same order.
- paymentStatus and executionStatus are separate state machines.
- Canonical error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
  QUOTE_EXPIRED, QUOTE_MISMATCH, PAYMENT_REQUIRED, SETTLEMENT_PENDING,
  SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN, PROVIDER_REJECTED, POLICY_DENIED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT,
  REFUND_REQUIRED, INTERNAL.

## Acceptance flow

search → quote → create order (HTTP 402 + payment requirements) → settle
(x402 proof) → execution → poll status → completion. A quote is mandatory
before ordering and is consumed exactly once.

## Commands (REST / MCP tool)

- getCapabilities — GET /v0/capabilities / get_capabilities
- listProviders — GET /v0/providers / list_providers
- registerProvider — POST /v0/providers / register_provider
- searchServices — GET /v0/services / search_services
- compareOffers — MCP tool compare_offers (gateway extension)
- getService — GET /v0/services/{id} / get_service
- getQuote — POST /v0/quotes / get_quote
- createOrder — POST /v0/orders / create_order
- getOrder — GET /v0/orders/{id} / get_order_status
- cancelOrder — POST /v0/orders/{id}/cancel / cancel_order
- requestRefill — POST /v0/orders/{id}/refill / request_refill

## Choosing a provider

GET /v0/providers lists pseudonymous nodes (providerKey, lifecycle,
capabilities, offersCount, gateway-measured metrics). Metrics are measured
by the gateway from real orders, never self-reported. Quality tiers are
derived with the open formula in spec/v0 §9.1 — recompute them yourself.

Every search_services offer carries providerRef (the providerKey of the node
serving it) and quality (measured orders, deliveredRatio, startLatencyMs;
ratio/latency appear only with sufficient sample). sort=price orders by
normalized unit price, sort=quality by measured quality, sort=relevance (the
default) keeps the catalog order; GET /v0/services accepts the same sort
parameter. compare_offers (platform + objective [+ quantity]) returns one
cheapest offer per provider, cheapest first, each with its measured quality
and the total price for your quantity — the direct answer to «who is cheaper
and who is more reliable for this». SUSPENDED providers never appear.
